component.name: Remote Desktop
component.summary: View and control this host's desktop from the browser

description.p: A fully web-based remote desktop for the host machine: noVNC running in the browser, tunneled through Cockpit's authenticated, TLS-encrypted WebSocket. Nothing to install on the client, no extra open ports.
Detects TigerVNC, x11vnc, wayvnc and GNOME Remote Desktop, manages the VNC service, guides setup, sets VNC passwords safely, and shows health checks and service logs.
